lines.text: Family group chat: Can someone grab milk?
By evening, there are three cartons in the fridge. Or none.
That's exactly how a lot of teams work. Just with shifts instead of milk.
Two people show up for the morning shift. Nobody for the evening.
When everyone can see what's already taken, nothing gets done twice. And nothing gets dropped.
FreiForms. Clarity for your team. More on our profile.
